events.verdict: Daniels (ATL) is in a legal defensive position in the post before Cunningham (DET) loses control of his dribble and the ball is deflected away. Both Daniels and Stewart (DET) have their hands on the loose ball when the whistle is blown for a held ball.
Okongwu (ATL) and Stewart (DET) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
Okongwu (ATL) firms up in a screening position and allows Beasley (DET) to avoid the contact.
Ivey (DET) establishes himself in a screening position and has his arm slightly extended outside of the frame of his body. The ensuing contact with Daniels (ATL) during the pick is marginal.
Johnson (ATL) cleanly blocks Harris's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Johnson (ATL) makes clean contact with the ball to prevent Stewart (DET) from making the pass.
The shot clock expires during Detroit's possession and a 24-second violation is correctly called.
Harris (DET) makes clean contact with the ball to secure the rebound. Any contact that occurs with Okongwu (ATL) is incidental.
Johnson (ATL) makes clean contact with the ball to temporarily dislodge it from Harris (DET).

events.verdict: Cunningham's (DET) pass goes out of bounds without being touched by an Atlanta player.
Stewart (DET) jumps into Young (ATL), initiating body contact that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Ivey (DET) establishes himself in a screening position in Daniels' (ATL) path and does not deliver contact.
Daniels (ATL) moves alongside Cunningham's (DET) path and maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt.
Cunningham (DET) makes contact with the ball and incidental contact with the part of Okongwu's (ATL) hand that is considered part of the ball to block the shot attempt.
